title: Optimistic Mutation: Snapshot, Speculate & Rollback
description: Step through cancelling stale refetches, applying an optimistic overlay, and rolling back on 500 error.

steps.label: 1. Snapshot Confirmed State & Cancel Refetches
steps.description: Before mutating, cancel any in-flight GETs so a stale response can't overwrite the optimistic UI.
steps.codeHighlight:
const prev = cache.get(['post', id]);
await queryClient.cancelQueries(['post', id]);

steps.label: 2. Apply Speculative Overlay (t=0ms)
steps.description: UI updates immediately to 42 likes while POST /like is in flight—keeping INP under 16ms.

steps.label: 3. Server Returns 500 -> Rollback
steps.description: Network fails at t=380ms. Rollback restores the confirmed snapshot (41) and surfaces a non-blocking retry toast.
